title: Hammond's QoL Vanilla+
description: Enjoy a smoother, more informative, and visually enhanced vanilla and vanilla+ SMP. This mod collection focuses on essential quality-of-life improvements for an unparalleled multiplayer experience.
body:
## Announcing the Release of **Hammonds 1.21 QoL Vanilla+**!

Experience Minecraft 1.21 like never before with **Hammonds 1.21 QoL Vanilla+**! This carefully curated modpack stays true to the heart of vanilla gameplay while injecting a significant dose of quality-of-life improvements, breathtaking visuals, optimized performance, and tools for content creation.

**Hammonds 1.21 QoL Vanilla+** enhances your world with:

* **Visual Enhancements:**
    * **Iris Shaders and Complementary Shaders - Unbound:** Dramatically overhaul the game's visuals with realistic lighting, shadows, reflections, and atmospheric effects for a much more immersive world.
    * **Faithful 64x:** Provide higher-resolution textures that stay true to the original Minecraft aesthetic but with much more detail.
    * **Dramatic Skys:** Deliver breathtaking and dynamic skies with realistic clouds, sunsets, and night skies.
    * **Motschen's Better Leaves:** Enhance the appearance of trees with more detailed and realistic leaf textures and models.
    * **Blur+:** Add a subtle blur effect to menus and backgrounds, making the interface more visually appealing.
    * **Dark Loading Screen:** Provide a simple but welcome change with a darker and potentially less jarring loading screen.
    * **Particle Rain:** Enhance the visual effect of rain with more detailed and numerous particles.
    * **Chunks fade in:** Make chunk loading less abrupt and more visually smooth.
* **Performance and Optimization:**
    * **Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore:** Core performance mods that significantly improve the game's frame rate, reduce lag, and optimize memory usage without altering gameplay.
    * **Fast IP Ping and Server Pinger Fixer:** Improve the speed and reliability of connecting to multiplayer servers.
* **Quality of Life and Information:**
    * **Jade 🔍 (Just Another Description Extractor):** Provide in-game tooltips with detailed information about blocks, items, and entities you're looking at.
    * **Shulker Box Tooltip:** Allow you to see the contents of shulker boxes without having to open them.
    * **Durability Tooltip:** Show the remaining durability of your tools and armor directly in your inventory.
    * **Held Item Info:** Display useful information about the item you're currently holding.
    * **AppleSkin:** Show how much hunger and saturation food items will restore.
    * **Status Effect Bars:** Display active status effects more clearly and intuitively.
    * **BetterF3:** Replace the default F3 debug screen with a more organized and informative version.
    * **Gamma Utils (Fullbright):** Allow you to easily toggle fullbright mode, making it easier to see in dark areas.
    * **Mouse Tweaks:** Add various mouse-based shortcuts for inventory management.
    * **Inventory Management:** Provide tools and shortcuts for organizing your inventory more efficiently.
    * **AutoSwitch:** Might automatically switch to the best tool in your inventory when you start mining or attacking.
    * **Low On Fire:** A small but helpful mod that reduces the visual intensity of being on fire.
    * **Chat Heads and Chat Animation [Smooth Chat]:** Enhance the chat interface with player avatars and smoother text animations.
    * **Litematica:** A powerful in-game schematic viewer and building tool, especially useful for complex constructions.
    * **Litematica Printer:** An addon for Litematica that assists with placing blocks according to a loaded schematic.
    * **JourneyMap and JourneyMap Web Map:** Provide a real-time in-game map and potentially a web-based interface to view your world.
    * **MapFrontiers:** Allow you to easily define and visualize world borders or explored areas on your map.
* **Content Creation Tools:**
    * **Flashback:** A recording mod that allows you to create in-game cinematics.
    * **Flashside:** Provides easy access to Flashback's controls by placing its buttons on the side of the menu screen.
* **Enhanced Entities:**
    * **[EMF] Entity Model Features and [ETF] Entity Texture Features:** Improve and allow for more varied and detailed entity models and textures.
    * **[ESF] Entity Sound Features:** Enhance the sound quality and variety for mobs.
    * **TslatEntityStatus:** Could provide more detailed status information about entities.
* **Functional and Technical Mods:**
    * **Fabric API:** A core library required by many Fabric mods to function correctly.
    * **YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL), Forge Config API Port, SuperMartijn642's Config Lib, and Cloth Config API:** These provide standardized in-game configuration menus for other mods, making customization easier.
    * **Mod Menu:** Adds a convenient in-game menu to browse and configure installed mods.
    * **Text Placeholder API:** A library for other mods to display dynamic text information.
    * **Sound Physics Remastered:** Immersively enhances the game's sound by adding realistic echoes, reverberation, and sound occlusion.
    * **LambDynamicLights:** Adds dynamic lighting effects to held items and moving entities.
    * **The Immersive Music Mod:** Replaces and enhances the game's default music with a more atmospheric and immersive soundtrack.
    * **VanillaTweaks\_r266558\_MC1.21.x.zip:** This is a collection of various small tweaks and improvements to the vanilla game available at [https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)

**Hammonds 1.21 QoL Vanilla+** is the perfect modpack for players who love the core Minecraft experience but crave a smoother, more informative, visually captivating, cinematically capable, and now featuring enhanced and more varied entities. It's Vanilla, but significantly enhanced!

**Download Hammonds 1.21 QoL Vanilla+ for Minecraft 1.21 today and rediscover your world, capture its beauty, and experience its creatures in a richer way!**

---

**Modpack Highlights:**

* High-performance optimization for smoother gameplay.
* Beautiful shaders and enhanced textures for a visual upgrade.
* Comprehensive in-game information and helpful tooltips.
* Powerful building and exploration utilities.
* Immersive sound and lighting enhancements.
* Integrated tools for creating stunning in-game cinematics.
* **Enhanced and more varied entity models, textures, and sounds.**
* A collection of quality-of-life tweaks and improvements.

**Get ready to experience Vanilla Minecraft like never before with Hammonds 1.21 QoL Vanilla+!**
